scope: Default-visible components after Mode C default promotion, deprecated retained workflow paths, and removed MCP/demo implementation after TASK-0051.

default_route.authoritative_runtime_path: scripts/run_real_agent_pilot.py defaults to mode_c_combined and is the default local real-Agent path after TASK-0051. It uses a real Planner and real bounded Executor on the tested local M1 bounded profile, while GoalOperationService still validates GoalExecutionRequest, admits immutable profile/adapter/runtime/store refs, compiles PlanDraft to PlanIR, creates durable SQLite GoalExecution state, executes through PlanExecutionService and StaticPlanScheduler, enforces Capability Admission, records Artifact/Evidence, and supports inspect/resume/cancel.

components.security_class: local process; no host, network, or secret isolation claim
components.side_effects: delegates to selected local commands and task state writers
components.artifact_evidence: task manifests, EvidenceGate reports, dynamic fixture reports

components.security_class: local CLI wrapper around Python services
components.side_effects: runs only the requested subcommand; workflow compatibility is hidden unless explicitly requested
components.artifact_evidence: structured JSON command output and task-local evidence files

components.security_class: fail-closed local service requiring immutable profile, adapter, runtime, store, and digest refs before side effects
components.side_effects: writes SQLite control state, goal artifacts, and capability-admitted workspace files only after request validation and PlanIR admission
components.artifact_evidence: goal-execution-request.json, plan-draft.json, plan-validation-report.json, plan-ir.json, goal-start-report.json, goal-resume-report.json, CLI JSON output

components.security_class: isolated deterministic regression fixture; capability gateway denies unauthorized writes before side effect
components.side_effects: writes a requested JSON report and mutates only a temporary fixture copy
components.artifact_evidence: dynamic fixture command report with claim, gate, evidence, audit, defect, repair, and completion sections

components.security_class: contract validation boundary
components.side_effects: none
components.artifact_evidence: schema-backed GoalContract, ClaimGraph, GateDefinition, and GatePlan artifacts

components.security_class: fail-closed evidence validity, supersession, current-set and completion boundary
components.side_effects: records evidence validity and supersession status in memory for local execution
components.artifact_evidence: fingerprinted Evidence v2 records, current-set metrics, multi-Claim Defects and completion results

components.security_class: untrusted planner output is validated and compiled before execution
components.side_effects: none until admitted PlanIR reaches scheduler
components.artifact_evidence: planner input artifact, PlanDraft, PlanIR, PlanPatch, and validation report

components.security_class: default-deny capability gateway
components.side_effects: authorizes or denies runtime side effects before execution
components.artifact_evidence: capability requests, grants, policy decisions, and audit records

components.security_class: lease/fencing-token state machine with mandatory Capability Admission before runtime side effects
components.side_effects: dispatches capability-admitted node executors and records artifacts/evidence
components.artifact_evidence: PlanExecution states, NodeRun states, checkpoints, admission refs, terminal failure records

components.security_class: local durable control-plane store with schema version checks and CAS writes
components.side_effects: creates or updates a local SQLite database only when selected by explicit store path
components.artifact_evidence: SQLite rows for goal_executions, plan_executions, node_runs, checkpoints, idempotency_records, and recovery_events

components.security_class: selected local executor adapter behind NodeExecutor port
components.side_effects: mutates only paths granted by the admitted PlanIR node
components.artifact_evidence: NodeRun results and task evidence records

components.security_class: shared bounded task AgentDriver phase adapter behind caller-supplied runtime and capability boundaries
components.side_effects: mutates only the caller-provided workspace through the caller-provided runtime and policy checks
components.artifact_evidence: task attempt artifacts, deterministic evidence, semantic review records, and WorkReport output
components.compatibility_scope: TaskHarness implementation remains hosted in standard_harness.py for compatibility; default-visible bounded Executor code imports it through task_harness.py until a future extraction task moves the implementation.
